story_intro: iumrah did not begin as an idea for another travel service. It began with experience.
story_p1: After spending more than a year in Makkah and staying close to pilgrims, we kept seeing the same problem: a journey people travel thousands of kilometres for too often depended on a large group, intermediaries and someone else’s schedule.
story_p2: We wanted to build another path — one where a person can perform Umrah independently, with family or friends, without being left alone with the organisation of the journey.
story_why_project_body: Because this path should never be considered finished. With every trip, every question and every new pilgrim need, iumrah should become better.
story_mission_body: Do not make the pilgrim understand the system. The system should understand the pilgrim’s trip.
